product_one_liner.value: voize is an AI voice assistant for nurses and caregivers that turns spoken observations into structured care documentation and transfers it into existing electronic care-record systems.

pricing_page.notes: Public page describes licensing by number of people receiving care rather than by user account; no numeric price is required for this classification.

employee_band.notes: The company About page reports 139 employees.

eng_blog.notes: Separate technical blog includes CTO Erik Ziegler’s on-device ML implementation article and ML Engineer Reuben Morais’s infrastructure-monitoring article.

public_docs.notes: Public help center has multiple collections, including 23 hospital articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Senior ML Engineer - Speech (m/f/d).

model_provider.value: Proprietary on-device speech/NLP models; Anthropic Claude via Amazon Bedrock for hosted text analysis; fine-tuned, self-hosted Mistral Small 3 for grammar correction.
model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list distinguishes product use of Claude through AWS Bedrock from direct Anthropic API use for internal processes and support.

compliance_certs.notes: Public compliance claims, not independent certifications: the US FAQ claims HIPAA compliance and BAAs, and GDPR-compliant processing under an Article 28 DPA.

last_funding.notes: Announced November 17, 2025; led by Balderton Capital.

raised_18mo.notes: The November 17, 2025 announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: September 23, 2026: official German hospital-product launch with bidirectional ORBIS U integration, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Luis Semprun joined as VP Engineering in September 2026; his announcement is dated September 8, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly names HubSpot and describes recording conversations and outcomes in the company CRM.
